name: Build NumPy 2.5.3 wheel for cp312 musllinux_1_2 aarch64
run:
set -eux
# Pull musllinux aarch64 image
docker pull quay.io/pypa/musllinux_1_2_aarch64:latest
# Build inside container and repair to musllinux_1_2 tag
docker run --rm \
  -e NPY_BLAS_ORDER=openblas \
  -e NPY_LAPACK_ORDER=openblas \
  -v "$PWD:/io" -w /io \
  quay.io/pypa/musllinux_1_2_aarch64:latest \
  /bin/sh -eux -c '
    apk update && apk add --no-cache build-base gfortran openblas-dev pkgconf patchelf
    PYBIN="/opt/python/cp312-cp312/bin/python"
    "$PYBIN" -m pip install -U pip setuptools wheel "cython>=3.0" meson-python ninja build
    "$PYBIN" -m build -w -o /io/dist
    WHEEL=$(ls /io/dist/numpy-*-cp312-*.whl | head -n1)
    auditwheel repair --plat musllinux_1_2_aarch64 -w /io/dist "$WHEEL"
  '
